course_name_original: ATA1032 — Atatürk İlkeleri ve İnkılâp Tarihi 2
course_name_en: Atatürk's Principles and History of Revolutions 2

learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain a general perspective to evaluate the history of the 20th century.
Students will evaluate the political, economic, and cultural policies of the early republican period.
Students will evaluate the political, economic, and cultural policies of the Democrat Party period.
Students will evaluate the political, economic, and cultural policies after 1980.
Students will evaluate the present day in the context of Republican history.

syllabus_topics: Formation of Atatürk's principles and republican ideology
1945-1950: Transition to multi-party political life in Turkey
Economic Development and Social Change in Turkey between 1960-1980
1980 coup and the rise of neo-liberalism
